thumbnails.concept_ko: 2026년 4월 14일, 리치스타리호가 48시간 안에 두 번째로 뱃머리를 돌렸다는 보고가 관제실에 들어온 순간의 시진핑. 대본 파트 6(13~15.5분, 통쾌함 절정)의 핵심 장면이고, 이 편의 감정은 '중국이 물러섰다'는 한 얼굴에 전부 걸려 있어 감정 클로즈업을 골랐다. 근거: verified-data.md 군사·해상 봉쇄 축 4항(SCMP·Newsweek 2026.04).
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the image height — that is the lowest 37%, roughly the bottom 270 pixels of a 720-pixel-tall frame — contains nothing but the dark matte surface of a control-room console desk running toward the camera, dark and free of detail so overlay text stays readable on it. Every face, hand, telephone handset, cup, paper and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The console desk runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on it sits at mid height. Frame the man from the chest up and place his head high, close to the top edge. Scene: photographed from inside a Chinese maritime traffic control room late at night, camera at standing eye level about two metres back. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands just right of centre, framed from the chest up, a folded paper report held low in his left hand. Behind him a bank of wall-mounted monitors shows a nautical chart of the Strait of Hormuz on which one single vessel track curves back on itself and returns the way it came, while every other lane on the screen is empty; the screen glow is dim and its lettering is small and out of focus. On the console at mid height sit a dented stainless thermos cup with a worn lid, a stack of printed shipping manifests with curled corners, a coil of tangled headset cable and a red desk phone lying off its cradle. Overhead fluorescent tubes mix with the cold blue spill from the monitors so the left side of his face is lit and the right side falls into shadow, and the room behind him is dark and unstaffed. Expression, the whole point of the frame: the inner ends of his eyebrows are pulled up and inward so two vertical creases stand out on his forehead, his eyes are open wide but focused down and away at the console rather than at the camera, his lower lip is caught and pressed under his upper teeth so the jaw muscle stands out along his cheek, his chin is tucked toward his collar, and his right hand grips the receiver of the red phone so the tendons across the back of the hand are raised — a man being told the ships turned back a second time. Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained color, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, wood, glass and metal. thumbnails.concept_ko: 2026년 3월, 페르시아만 안에 중국 국적선 55척이 만재 상태로 갇힌 장면. 배는 이렇게 많은데 단 한 척도 움직이지 못한다는 규모의 모순이 곧 메시지라 스케일 대비를 골랐다. 진영 서사 무명인 금지에 따라 선원을 세우지 않고 선체·닻사슬·COSCO 표기로만 화면을 세웠다. 근거: verified-data.md 4항(CSIS 2026.03).

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 국가 상징이 하늘 전체를 덮고 있는데, 바로 그 아래는 무너져 있다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 좌 8할(상황)과 우 2할(인물)을 인물 실루엣이 가르는 경계선 · 거리 정면에 서 있는 눈높이로 소실점이 화면 안쪽으로 빨려 들어가는 정면 원근(시점은 뒤집지 않는다) · 인물은 우측 가슴 위, 화면 높이 약 6할 / [바꿈] 장소(불타는 상하이 도심 → 배 한 척 없는 컨테이너 부두) · 자세와 손동작(정면 응시하며 말하는 중 → 무전기를 쥔 손을 허벅지 옆으로 내리고 시선은 수평선 좌하향) · 관찰 디테일(화염·잔해·도망치는 군중 → 볼라드에 감긴 채 물에 늘어진 계류 로프와 선석 번호만 남은 빈 부두). ※ 인물 고정 판정: 이 모순의 '국가 상징' 자리를 무명인으로 바꿔 읽으면 문장이 성립하지 않는다 → 우측 인물은 3장 모두 시진핑으로 고정하고, 대신 장소·자세·디테일·색온도를 장마다 굴렸다. 앵커의 화염·붕괴 그래픽은 실사형에서 재현하지 않고 '실제로 비어 있는 장면'으로 같은 모순을 만든다. 거리감은 수평선까지 열린 원경.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. Every face, hand, flag, coil stack, chimney and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Frame the man from the chest up, place his head high and close to the top edge, and let the frame cut him off at chest level right at the five-eighths line. Scene: photographed standing in the storage yard of a Chinese steel works on a flat overcast day, camera at standing eye level, dead frontal perspective with the vanishing point pulled deep into the centre of the frame so the rows of stacked steel run straight away from the viewer. The left four-fifths of the picture is the mill: an enormous real Chinese national flag banner, red with five yellow stars, is fixed across the whole upper wall of the mill building and spreads over the top of the frame, and directly beneath it the yard is dead — rows of steel coils stacked three high with nobody moving between them, two tall chimneys behind with no smoke at all, a loading truck parked with its bed empty and its cab door hanging open. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands in the right fifth of the frame, framed from the chest up at about six-tenths of the frame height, his shoulder line forming the vertical edge that divides the dead yard from him. The light is flat, cold and shadowless daylight, so the whole picture is grey except the single large red mass of the banner across the top. Expression and posture: his eyes are open wide with the pupils rolled upward so a little white shows below the iris as he looks up at how high the coils are stacked, his eyebrows are lifted enough to put three horizontal creases across his forehead, his mouth hangs slightly open showing the lower teeth, and his left hand has taken hold of a torn corner of the plastic wrapping on the nearest coil and stopped there without pulling. Observed detail that proves someone really stood here: the wrapping on the stacks is split open and flapping, brown water stains have bloomed across the exposed steel from months of rain, and a paper dispatch tag wired to the nearest coil has faded to blank. Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained color, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, steel, plastic and concrete. Signs may clip a little but the overall image stays natural — never glowing, never hyper-saturated, no HDR look, no rim-light effects, no lens flare. No graphic overlays of any kind: no arrows, no highlight circles, no cracks, no sparks, no smoke effects, no inset panels, no fire. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.
